titulo.alumno:
«Процесс и результат в прошлом»
Process and result in the past

intro: The past imperfective presents an activity in progress or the context; the perfective focuses on a result or a completed fact.

frases.alumno: When I called, Anna was reading.
By the evening, Anna had read the letter.

piezas.titulo: The past imperfective presents an activity in progress or the context; the perfective focuses on a result or a completed fact.
texto: The past imperfective presents an activity in progress or the context; the perfective focuses on a result or a completed fact.
Я читал книгу can mean I was reading the book; Я прочитал книгу indicates that I finished it.

pregunta.texto: Which form highlights that the letter was finished?

opciones.explicacion: The prefix про- here marks the complete result.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Когда я позвонил, Анна читала.»

opciones.texto: When I called, Anna was reading.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: By the evening, Anna had read the letter.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: By the evening, Anna had read the letter.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
